# Galino Solutions

## About
Galino Solutions is a family-owned home services and home inspection company based in Miami, Florida, founded by Luis Galino. The company provides professional home renovation and repair services alongside certified home inspections, serving homeowners, buyers, sellers, and real estate professionals throughout South Florida. Galino Solutions is licensed and insured, with over 10 years of experience in professional home services.

## Services and Pricing
- Full Residential Home Inspection — starting from $350
- 4-Point Inspection — for insurance renewal on older homes
- Wind Mitigation Inspection — documents storm-resistant features for potential insurance discounts
- Bathroom Renovation — starting from $5,000
- Kitchen Renovation — starting from $6,000
- Remodeling (kitchen, bathroom, whole-home)
- Painting (interior and exterior)
- Drywall installation and repair
- Gutter cleaning and installation
- Junk removal
- Pressure washing
- Handyman services
- Plumbing repair and installation
- Electrical repair and installation
- Flooring installation (tile, laminate, vinyl)
- Free estimates on all professional services

## Locations

## What Makes Us Different
Galino Solutions combines two services under one trusted, local team: hands-on home repair and remodeling, and certified home inspections. Customers get free estimates, fast scheduling, and same-day inspection reports, backed by more than a decade of professional experience. The company is licensed, insured, and family-run, with a bilingual team serving Miami-Dade and Broward counties.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How much does a home inspection cost?**
A Full Residential Inspection starts at $350. Pricing varies by home size and the type of inspection needed (4-Point, Wind Mitigation, or Full Residential). Contact Galino Solutions for an exact quote.

**How much does a bathroom or kitchen renovation cost?**
Bathroom renovations start at $5,000. Kitchen renovations start at $6,000. Final pricing depends on the scope of work, materials, and size of the space.

**How fast can I get my inspection report?**
Galino Solutions provides same-day inspection reports in most cases, so buyers and sellers aren't left waiting during time-sensitive real estate transactions.

**Is Galino Solutions licensed and insured?**
Yes. Galino Solutions is licensed and insured for home inspection services and carries over 10 years of experience in professional home services.

**Do you offer free estimates?**
Yes, free estimates are provided for all professional home services, including remodeling, painting, plumbing, electrical, and other repair or renovation work.

**What areas do you serve?**
Galino Solutions serves Miami-Dade and Broward counties, including Miami, Fort Lauderdale, Hialeah, Coral Gables, Doral, Homestead, Pembroke Pines, Hollywood, Miramar, Aventura, and Kendall.

**What's the difference between a 4-Point Inspection and a Full Residential Inspection?**
A 4-Point Inspection focuses on four major systems (roof, electrical, plumbing, and HVAC) and is typically required by insurance companies for older homes. A Full Residential Inspection is a comprehensive, top-to-bottom evaluation of the entire property, recommended for buyers and sellers.

**Does Galino Solutions speak Spanish?**
Yes. Galino Solutions has a bilingual team and provides service in both English and Spanish.
